items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I know when Arthur went to Chicago years ago

ctx.x: No, this guy's been gone to Chicago for years Oh That's why I never did see him
I know when Arthur went to Chicago years ago This guy's got Peter Lally Caber with Peter Buckhart Must be the same He's a tall fella Tall I don't know if he still lives or not I don't know
I don't know either What about Paggio? You said you played with them, huh?
